name: R1
summary: Mid-tier edition of Unitree's R1 humanoid line (between R1 AIR and R1 EDU): about 1.23 m and 29 kg, 26 joints (6 per leg, 5 per arm, 2 waist, 2 head), binocular camera, 4-mic array and speaker, 8-core processor, about 1 h battery life, 8-month warranty. Secondary development is not supported on this edition (R1 EDU only). Manufacturer list price $5,900 excluding tax and shipping. Sources: unitree.com/R1 and shop.unitree.com, agent-retrieved 2026-09-11.
specs_note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-09-11 by Claude Opus 5 (curl + WebFetch) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny for European Catalogue Gap Batch 01B, under research work order 'OWNER WORK ORDER — BATCH 01B COMMERCIAL RESEARCH' (2026-09-11; docs/26 §2.1). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading. Not human-verified. Values from Unitree's R1 parameter table, 'R1' column (unitree.com/R1): height_cm 123.0 ('1230x357x190mm' standing), weight_kg 29.0 ('About 29kg'), degrees_of_freedom 26 (6 per leg, 5 per arm, 2 waist, 2 head), runtime_minutes 60 ('About 1h'). payload_kg UNKNOWN (owner decision, 2026-09-11): the row is labelled 'Maximum Torque of Arm Joint【1】' but reads 'About 2kg' (footnote 【1】 refers to 'the maximum load of the arm') — internally inconsistent source wording, and the owner capture that corroborates 2 kg has no source URL. has_sdk FALSE and developer_edition FALSE: 'Secondary Development【2】' is '/' for R1 and 'YES' only for R1 EDU; reichelt's listing agrees ('Basismodell, nicht frei programmierbar'). hand_type and hand_dof UNKNOWN (owner decision, 2026-09-11 — hand_dof held explicitly; hand_type held for the same reason, its only support being the same URL-less capture): Unitree lists 'Dexterous Hand' as '/' for R1; an owner-supplied capture of a RobotShop US listing (captured 2026-08-17; NO source URL — limitation recorded, no URL invented) states 'Hand Type Dummy hands' and 'Hand DOF (per hand) 0 (dummy hands)'. has_language_ui: 'Integrated with a Large Multimodal Model for voice and images' plus 4-mic array and speaker — series-level claim, MEDIUM (footnote [7]: some sample functions still in development). CONFLICTS preserved: (1) DoF — reichelt 'R1 Base' lists 'DOF: 24' and 'Total degrees of freedom: 24 DOF (up to 40 DOF depending on the model)'; the owner capture's prose says 'twenty-four actuated degrees of freedom' while its own table says 26; Unitree says 26 for R1 (and 20 for R1 AIR). Manufacturer value used. (2) Height — reichelt 'Length: 1210 mm'; capture prose '1,210 mm' vs its table '1230×357×190 mm'; Unitree 1230 mm used. (3) Weight — reichelt 'Weight: 25000 g' and 'Weight (manufacturer specs): 40 kg'; Unitree 29 kg used. The reichelt/QUADRUPED 'R1 Base' spec rows (24 DoF, 25 kg, 1210 mm) look like an older launch-era sheet; they do not match any current Unitree edition exactly, which is why the reichelt identity mapping is MEDIUM. has_api, ros_support, simulation_support, autonomy, walk_speed, battery_wh, reach and arm span are not stated for this edition and stay UNKNOWN. model_code stays NULL: sellers use different part numbers ('R1 BASE' at reichelt, 'R1-Basic' in the RobotShop capture) and Unitree publishes none.

spec_caveats.text: 26 per Unitree's R1 column. reichelt's listing states 24 DOF and QUADRUPED.DE repeats it; an owner-supplied capture says 26 in its table and 'twenty-four' in its prose. The manufacturer figure is used and the others are preserved here.
123 cm from Unitree's standing dimensions (1230 mm). reichelt lists 1210 mm.
About 29 kg per Unitree. reichelt lists 25 kg and, separately, 40 kg.

Not recorded. Unitree's R1 row is labelled 'Maximum Torque of Arm Joint' but reads 'About 2kg', and its footnote refers to the maximum LOAD of the arm — the source wording is internally inconsistent, so no payload is stated here.

Unitree's R1 column lists the dexterous hand as not specified for this edition, which states nothing about the standard end effector. The only description of 'dummy hands' comes from an owner-supplied capture that carries no source URL.
